name: father
trans: n. a male parent (also used as a term of address to your father); the founder of a family
v. make children

name: mother
trans: n. a woman who has given birth to a child (also used as a term of address to your mother)
v. care for like a mother

name: brother
trans: n. a male with the same parents as someone else; a male person who is a fellow member (of a fraternity or religion or other group)

name: sister
trans: n. a female person who has the same parents as another person

name: grandmother
trans: n. the mother of your father or mother

name: grandfather
trans: n. the father of your father or mother

name: who
trans: pron. what or which person or people
pron. introducing a clause that describes a person

name: he
trans: pron. a male person or animal previously mentioned

name: she
trans: pron. a female person or animal previously mentioned

name: classmate
trans: n. an acquaintance that you go to school with

name: friend
trans: n. a person you know well and regard with affection and trust; an associate who provides cooperation or assistance

name: woman
trans: n. an adult female person (as opposed to a man); a female person who plays a significant role (wife or mistress or girlfriend) in the life of a particular man

name: girl
trans: n. a young woman; a youthful female person

name: man
trans: n. an adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman); someone who serves in the armed forces; a member of a military force
v. take charge of a certain job; occupy a certain work place

name: boy
trans: n. a youthful male person; a friendly informal reference to a grown man

name: look
trans: v. perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards; give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect
n. the feelings expressed on a person's face; the act of directing the eyes toward something and perceiving it visually

name: his
trans: det. belonging to or associated with a male person previously mentioned
pron. the one(s) belonging to him

name: name
trans: n. a language unit by which a person or thing is known; a person's reputation
v. assign a specified (usually proper) proper name to

name: her
trans: pron. a female person or animal, as the object of a verb or preposition
det. belonging to or associated with a female person previously mentioned

name: or
trans: conj. used to link alternatives

name: big
trans: adj. above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent; significant
adv. extremely well; in a boastful manner

name: tall
trans: adj. great in vertical dimension; high in stature

name: pretty
trans: adv. to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
adj. pleasing by delicacy or grace; not imposing; (used ironically) unexpectedly bad

name: thin
trans: adj. of relatively small extent from one surface to the opposite or in cross section; lacking excess flesh
v. lose thickness; become thin or thinner

name: short
trans: adj. primarily temporal sense; indicating or being or seeming to be limited in duration; (primarily spatial sense) having little length or lacking in length
n. the location on a baseball field where the shortstop is stationed
adv. quickly and without warning

name: handsome
trans: adj. pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion; given or giving freely

name: new
trans: adj. not of long duration; having just (or relatively recently) come into being or been made or acquired or discovered; original and of a kind not seen before
adv. very recently

name: does
trans: v. third person singular present of "do"

name: bookshop
trans: n. a shop where books are sold

name: zoo
trans: n. the facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition

name: school
trans: n. an educational institution; a building where young people receive education
v. educate in or as if in a school

name: supermarket
trans: n. a large self-service grocery store selling groceries and dairy products and household goods

name: park
trans: n. a large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property; a piece of open land for recreational use in an urban area
v. place temporarily; maneuver a vehicle into a parking space

name: hospital
trans: n. a health facility where patients receive treatment

name: go
trans: v. change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically; follow a procedure or take a course

name: to
trans: prep. in the direction of; towards
prep. used before a verb to form the infinitive

name: grass
trans: n. narrow-leaved green herbage: grown as lawns; used as pasture for grazing animals; cut and dried as hay
v. shoot down, of birds

name: tree
trans: n. a tall perennial woody plant having a main trunk and branches forming a distinct elevated crown; includes both gymnosperms and angiosperms

name: flower
trans: n. a plant cultivated for its blooms or blossoms; reproductive organ of angiosperm plants especially one having showy or colorful parts
v. produce or yield flowers

name: boat
trans: n. a small vessel for travel on water

name: lake
trans: n. a body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land

name: hill
trans: n. a local and well-defined elevation of the land; structure consisting of an artificial heap or bank usually of earth or stones

name: Christmas
trans: n. period extending from Dec. 24 to Jan. 6; a Christian holiday celebrating the birth of Christ; a quarter day in England, Wales, and Ireland

name: Father Christmas
trans: n. the legendary patron saint of children; an imaginary being who is thought to bring presents to children at Christmas

name: Christmas tree
trans: n. Australian tree or shrub with red flowers; often used in Christmas decoration

name: card
trans: n. one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes

name: present
trans: v. give an exhibition of to an interested audience; bring forward and present to the mind
adj. temporal sense; intermediate between past and future; now existing or happening or in consideration; being or existing in a specified place
n. the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech; something presented as a gift

name: New Year
trans: n. the calendar year just begun

name: merry
trans: adj. full of or showing high-spirited merriment; offering fun and gaiety

name: too
trans: adv. to a degree exceeding normal or proper limits; in addition

name: here
trans: adv. in or at this place; where the speaker or writer is; in this circumstance or respect or on this point or detail
adj. being here now
n. the present location; this place

name: for
trans: prep. intended to belong to or be used by
prep. in order to help or benefit
prep. during (a period of time); in place of

name: thank
trans: v. express gratitude or show appreciation to

name: happy
trans: adj. enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure; marked by good fortune
